A whitespace-only inline element contributes exactly one space

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>A<i> </i>B</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
